fidelity_misses: menu-preview.png has the requested 1275 × 2100 pixels but no 150 dpi resolution metadata.

defects.where: menu.pdf.page-1.png and menu-preview.png.overview.png, top navy title panel
defects.what: The large solid navy masthead consumes considerable ink for a desktop-printed menu and gives the branding disproportionately more space than the tightly packed menu sections.

AOSO.craft_notes: Clean serif menu with clear leaders, aligned decimal prices and well-separated sans-serif section headings. The seasonal panel and amber dietary markers aid scanning; the small wave/sun emblem is competent but generic. All eight round-1 views inspected. PDF is Legal, uses real text with Type3 glyphs, and its smallest measured text is approximately 9.5 pt; no clipping observed.
AOSO.revision_notes: All eight retained Coffee-section prices increase by $0.25, Drip refill is removed, and the exact oat-milk note sits below Coffee. Remaining copy, prices and design are retained, with a negligible downstream reflow from replacing the row with a note. Interpreted 'every coffee price' as the named Coffee section; seasonal drinks remain unchanged in both entries.

defects.where: menu.pdf.page-1.png and menu-preview.png crops, beneath COFFEE, TEA, BAKERY and SEASONAL headings
defects.what: Amber rules sit tightly between the heading baseline and first item, crowding each section's opening despite ample space between sections.

FKJR.craft_notes: Readable restrained serif/sans menu with consistent leaders and price columns. Text and edges remain crisp in all eight round-1 views. Legal PDF has embedded fonts and a smallest measured text size of approximately 11.5 pt; preview dimensions and 150 dpi metadata are correct. Section-opening spacing is the main refinement needed.
FKJR.revision_notes: All eight retained Coffee prices rise by $0.25; Drip refill is replaced by the exact Oat milk +$0.75 note. Unchanged items, section positions, typography and footer are preserved. The request is interpreted as applying to the Coffee section, not the separately listed Seasonal drinks.

pairwise_round1.why: AOSO's better-separated section headings and distinct seasonal panel make the menu easier to scan, although its large dark masthead is less economical to print.
